Marginal call examined and NOT filed: line 72's Mollick annotation ends 'Carry the open question into Module 5, where you start adding checks around a session: each one is a claim that this is a place the model still needs you, and claims like that expire.' The 2026-08-23 amendment ('## Pre-reads before Module N does NOT inherit ## Prework's exemption... of AE101's three pre-reads sections, exactly one narrated a later module') most plausibly names this exact sentence as its evidence (of the three AE101 Pre-reads sections — getting-going.md M2, this file's M5, learn-from-the-test.md M6 — this is the one whose Pre-reads paragraph itself, not just its exempt trailing ## Next, states what a later module's session will do). Re-ran the subject+predicate test against the CURRENT sentence rather than trusting that inference: the predicate clause keeps 'you' as its own grammatical subject ('you start adding checks'), matching rule 28's approved forward-callout shape ('when this loop has to scale past you'), not the banned 'the training shows you where the rest goes' shape where an institution is the actor. Cutting it would also remove the only sentence tying Mollick's unresolved bet to why the training deliberately leaves it open across the M4/M5 boundary, a genuine connective function distinct from cartography. Not filed as REVISE: harm is contested and the fix would cost real connective value: the maintainer's own carve-out language is closer to a standing rule question than a settled violation on this specific sentence, and this dispatch's own preamble instructs reporting a contested case rather than filing it.
